subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about scaling first-purchase volume for {Brand} in the US. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the confirmed first purchase with order ID and revenue attached, read back through an S2S postback from your MMP before it counts, with a returns window that de-credits orders that bounce. That keeps the install as upstream funnel only and the paid order as the event you actually buy, around 8,000 purchases a day at scale. Worth a short look at the category-level purchase view for your tier?
illustrative_flags: 8,000 purchases a day (MobUpps daily purchase volume, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN ecommerce/US: references prior in first sentences; restates single proof (confirmed first purchase, order ID + revenue, S2S MMP postback, returns window); one illustrative figure (8,000 purchases/day); soft CTA, 1 question mark; native en; no sign-off; no X-not-Y.
